payload.posture: Read Exodus 12:21–28 as one movement in Passover, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states moses tells the elders to kill the Passover, apply blood with hyssop, remain inside, preserve the ordinance, and answer children who ask about the service. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Passover.
